pr_title: HTTP/2: Ensure newStream() is called only once per connection upgrade and the correct handler is used
pr_body:
Motivation:

306299323cd47fed6d15767291a3d52e48d16786 introduced some code change to move the responsibility of creating the stream for the upgrade to Http2FrameCodec. Unfortunaly this lead to the situation of having newStream().setStreamAndProperty(...) be called twice. Because of this we only ever saw the channelActive(...) on Http2StreamChannel but no other events as the mapping was replaced on the second newStream().setStreamAndProperty(...) call.

Beside this we also did not use the correct handler for the upgrade stream in some cases

Modifications:

- Just remove the Http2FrameCodec.onHttpClientUpgrade() method and so let the base class handle all of it. The stream is created correctly as part of the ConnectionListener implementation of Http2FrameCodec already.
- Consolidate logic of creating stream channels
- Adjust unit test to capture the bug

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/9395

issue_context.title: Commit 306299323cd seems to have broken finagle tests
issue_context.body:
### Expected behavior

Using the 4.1.38.Final-SNAPSHOT would not break out internal tests

### Actual behavior

Tests broken

### Steps to reproduce

Checkout commit 306299323cd (or later) and run the finagle tests. 

### Netty version

Snapshot SHA 306299323cd.

I don't yet know why it's broken, it could be finagle depending on a bug, but I wanted to file a ticket to let you know so if we need a fix we can get it into 4.1.38.Final. I'm looking into the issue now.
comments: @bryce-anderson btw as this was only some cleanup we can also revert the commit while trying to figure out what's wrong. WDYT ?
Let me try master with this reverted and we can go from there.

Revert does fix it. It's a small enough diff that we might be able to sort it out pretty quick. Do you want to wait until tomorrow before reverting to give me a few hours to check how to fix it? The revert isn't 100% clean.

Added some comments to the commit.
https://github.com/netty/netty/commit/306299323cd47fed6d15767291a3d52e48d16786#r34402442

review_comments: This feels pretty brittle. Would this be better as a protected member of `Http2ChannelDuplexHandler` which has access to the `connection()` through the `frameCodec` field?
we could do this but I wanted to keep the handlers as much as separated as possible ...

This looks identical to the Http2MultiplexHandler code other than the type of `AbstractHttp2StreamChannel` created (`Http2MultiplexCodecStreamChannel` vs `Http2MultiplexHandlerStreamChannel`). Could that be lifted into `Http2ChannelDuplexHandler`?
Maybe it's okay since the multiplex codec is deprecated and presumably will be removed at some point?
